stem: A body of mass m is projected horizontally with a velocity v from the top of a tower of height h and it reaches the ground at a distance x from the foot of the tower. If a second body of mass 2 m is projected horizontally from the top of a tower of height 2h, it reaches the ground at a distance 2x from the foot of the tower. Find the horizontal velocity of the second body?

assets.alt: Two horizontal throws: from height h at speed v landing at x, and from height 2h at speed v′ = √2·v landing at 2x.
